mechanisms.name: F16 activation-B staging for fused quantized matmul
mechanisms.evidence: Measured Laurent Q4/Q5/Q6 GPU time is 280.367/634.229 ms at C2/C8 versus hipEngine 359.416/832.620 ms; pinned source defaults quantized MUL_MAT to F16 B and states that it halves B bytes and shared memory.
mechanisms.inference: Portability to hipEngine production BF16 is unproven and requires a T2 numerical gate; the bound assumes the measured quant-time delta transfers while all other wall is unchanged.
mechanisms.entry: passes bound; eligible for Z3 RED planning as T2

mechanisms.name: 64/256-row prompt chunking
mechanisms.evidence: Laurent measures rows72 as 64+8 and rows288 as 256+32.
mechanisms.inference: Not a standalone candidate: hipEngine already executes each grouped shape as one direct tick, so chunking cannot be credited with Laurent's gain.

mechanisms.name: launch-count reduction
mechanisms.evidence: Laurent records 3588 node dispatches versus 1955 classified hipEngine dispatches.
mechanisms.inference: The sign is opposite the hypothesis.

decision: Advance only F16 activation-B staging to Z3. C2 remains an M=35-96 owner plus admission problem; C8 shares the same quantized-matmul dataflow. Exact occupancy and weight-fetch bytes remain unavailable and are not used in the bound.
